Sounds & movement.path: Back, cracking cervical region, rising from stooping, on
Sounds & movement.en: A cracking or clicking sound or feeling in the neck when straightening up after bending forward.
Sounds & movement.hi: झुकने के बाद सीधे उठते समय गर्दन की हड्डियों में चटकने की आवाज आती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Jhukne ke baad seedhe uthte samay gardan ki haddi mein chatakne ki aavaz ati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, cracking cervical region, stooping, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: Your neck (upper spine) cracks when you bend forward to stoop down.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: आगे झुकने पर गर्दन की हड्डियों में चटकने की आवाज आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Aage jhukne par gardan ki haddi mein chatakne ki aavaz ati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, crawling, dorsal region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling sensation in the middle part of your back (between the shoulder blades).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से में जैसे कुछ रेंग रहा हो, ऐसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke beech ke hisse mein jaise kuch reng raha ho, aisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, crawling, dorsal region, scapulae
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling sensation around your shoulder blades.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच में कंधे की हड्डियों के आसपास रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke beech mein kandhe ki haddiyon ke aaspas rengne jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, crawling, dorsal region, scapulae, left
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling sensation around your left shoulder blade.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच में बाईं कंधे की हड्डी के पास रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke beech mein baayin kandhe ki haddi ke paas rengne jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, crawling, dorsal region, scapulae, right
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling sensation around your right shoulder blade.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच में दाईं कंधे की हड्डी के पास रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke beech mein daayin kandhe ki haddi ke paas rengne jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, crawling, lumbar region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling sensation in your lower back.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein rengne jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, crawling, sacral region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling sensation in the area at the very base of your spine (tailbone area).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के निचले हिस्से (कमर-त्रिकास्थि) में रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke neeche hisse (kamar-trikaasthi) mein rengne jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, crawling, vertebrae
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling sensation along the bones of your spine.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी के जोड़ों में रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Ridh ki haddi ke jodoan mein rengne jaisa mehsus hota hai.

General.en: The curved or bent spine is in the neck region.
General.hi: गर्दन वाले हिस्से में रीढ़ की हड्डी टेढ़ी हो गई है।
General.roman: Gardan wale hisse mein reedh ki haddi tedhi ho gayi hai.

General.en: The curved or bent spine is in the mid-back region.
General.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में रीढ़ की हड्डी टेढ़ी हो गई है।
General.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse mein reedh ki haddi tedhi ho gayi hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Back, curvature of spine, lies on back with knees drawn up
Linked to posture/position.en: You tend to lie on your back with your knees pulled up toward your chest due to a spinal curve.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ की रीढ़ टेढ़ी होने के कारण पीठ के बल लेटने पर घुटने मोड़कर लेटना पड़ता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Peeth ki reedh tedhi hone ke karan peeth ke bal letne par ghutne modkar letna padta hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, curvature of spine, pain in
Type of pain.en: There is pain associated with the curved or bent spine.
Type of pain.hi: रीढ़ की टेढ़ेपन में दर्द भी होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Reedh ki tedhepen mein dard bhi hota hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The skin on your back has a bluish discolouration.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ की त्वचा नीली पड़ गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth ki tvachha nili pad gayi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The skin at the back of your neck has a bluish discolouration.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पीछे (नेप) की त्वचा नीली पड़ गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke peeche nape ki tvachha nili pad gayi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, discoloration, bluish, right side of back
Skin/tissue changes.en: The skin on the right side of your back has a bluish discolouration.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के दाईं तरफ की त्वचा नीली पड़ गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth ke daiein taraf ki tvachha nili pad gayi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The skin on your back has a brown discolouration.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ की त्वचा भूरे रंग की हो गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth ki tvachha bhure rang ki ho gayi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, discoloration, brown spots on, skin of neck brown and greasy, spots on shoulders
Skin/tissue changes.en: The skin on your back has brown spots, the skin of your neck appears brown and greasy, and there are spots on your shoulders.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन की त्वचा भूरी और चिकनाईदार है, और कंधों पर भूरे धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ki tvachha bhuri aur chiknaidaar hai aur kandhon par bhure dhabhe hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, discoloration, brown, skin of neck brown and greasy
Skin/tissue changes.en: The skin on your neck looks brown and feels greasy.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन की त्वचा भूरी और चिकनाईदार हो गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ki tvachha bhuri aur chiknaidaar ho gayi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are brown spots on the skin of your back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर भूरे रंग के धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par bhure rang ke dhabhe hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, discoloration, brown, spots on shoulders
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are brown spots on your shoulders.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कंधों पर भूरे रंग के धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kandhon par bhure rang ke dhabhe hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The skin on the back of your neck is red or reddened.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के हिस्से (सर्वाइकल क्षेत्र) की त्वचा लाल हो गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke hisse servical kshetra ki tvachha lal ho gayi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are spots (patches of discolouration) on the skin of your back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर रंगीन धब्बे पड़ गए हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par rangin dhabhe pad gaye hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, discoloration, spots on, dorsal region
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are spots (patches of discolouration) on the skin of your mid-back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से (कंधे से कमर के बीच) पर धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse kandhe se kamar ke beech par dhabhe hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, discoloration, spots on, lumbar region
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are spots (patches of discolouration) on the skin of your lower back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के कमर वाले हिस्से पर धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth ke kamar wale hisse par dhabhe hain.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, dislocation, dorsal vertebra, sensation of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: It feels as though one of the bones in the middle of your back has slipped out of place.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच की हड्डी (डोर्सल वर्टेब्रा) खिसकी हुई जैसी लगती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth ke beech ki haddi (dorsal vertebra) khiski hui jaisi lagti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, dislocation, last lumbar vertebra, sensation of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: It feels as though the lowest bone of your lower back has slipped out of place.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ की सबसे नीचे वाली कमर की हड्डी खिसकी हुई जैसी महसूस होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth ki sabse neeche wali kamar ki haddi khiski hui jaisi mehsus hoti hai.

General.en: Your lower back is twisted or distorted out of its normal shape.
General.hi: कमर की हड्डी टेढ़ी हो गई है।
General.roman: Kamar ki haddi tedhi ho gayi hai.

General.en: Your spine is twisted or distorted out of its normal shape.
General.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी टेढ़ी हो गई है।
General.roman: Reedh ki haddi tedhi ho gayi hai.

General.en: One or more of your spinal bones (vertebrae) are twisted or distorted out of their normal position.
General.hi: पीठ की कशेरुकाएँ (vertebrae) टेढ़ी हो गई हैं।
General.roman: Peeth ki kasherukayen tedhi ho gayi hain.

General.en: A general problem in the back of the mid-back area.
General.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से में पीठ की तरफ तकलीफ है।
General.roman: Peeth ke beech ke hisse mein peeth ki taraf taklif hai.

General.path: Back, dorsal region, back, left, right
General.en: A general problem in the mid-back area affecting both the left and right sides.
General.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से में बाईं और दाईं दोनों तरफ तकलीफ है।
General.roman: Peeth ke beech ke hisse mein bayin aur dayin dono taraf taklif hai.

General.en: A general problem on the left side of your mid-back.
General.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से में बाईं तरफ तकलीफ है।
General.roman: Peeth ke beech ke hisse mein bayin taraf taklif hai.

General.en: A general problem on the right side of your mid-back.
General.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से में दाईं तरफ तकलीफ है।
General.roman: Peeth ke beech ke hisse mein dayin taraf taklif hai.

General.en: A general problem affecting your shoulder blade area.
General.hi: कंधे की हड्डियों (स्कैपुला) में तकलीफ है।
General.roman: Kandhe ki haddiyon (scapula) mein taklif hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, drawn together, as if
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Your shoulder blades feel as though they are being pulled or drawn together toward each other.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे कंधे की दोनों हड्डियाँ एक-दूसरे की तरफ खिंच रही हैं।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise kandhe ki dono haddiyan ek-dusre ki taraf khinch rahi hain.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, inward, as if bent
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Your shoulder blades feel as though they are being bent inward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे कंधे की हड्डियाँ अंदर की तरफ मुड़ रही हैं।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise kandhe ki haddiyan andar ki taraf mud rahi hain.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, pressed apart, as if
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Your shoulder blades feel as though they are being pushed apart from each other.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे कंधे की हड्डियाँ एक-दूसरे से अलग धकेली जा रही हैं।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise kandhe ki haddiyan ek-dusre se alag dhakeli ja rahi hain.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms that start at the shoulder blades and spread to other areas.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी (स्कैपुला) से तकलीफ दूसरी जगह फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kandhe ki haddi (scapula) se taklif dusri jagah failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, arm
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades down into your arm.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ बाँह में फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kandhe ki haddi ki taklif bah mein failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, arm, left, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades into your left arm.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ बाईं बाँह में फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kandhe ki haddi ki taklif bayin bah mein failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, arm, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades into your arm.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ बाँह की तरफ फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kandhe ki haddi ki taklif bah ki taraf failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, chest, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades into your chest.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ छाती की तरफ फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: kandhe ki haddi ki taklif chhati ki taraf failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, elbow, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades down to your elbow.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ कोहनी तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: kandhe ki haddi ki taklif kohni tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, epigastrium, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades down to your upper-middle belly.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: kandhe ki haddi ki taklif pet ke upar hisse tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, nape, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades up to the back of your neck.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ गर्दन के पीछे तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: kandhe ki haddi ki taklif gardan ke piche tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, shoulder
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades into your shoulder.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ कंधे तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: kandhe ki haddi ki taklif kandhe tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, shoulder, left, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades into your left shoulder.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ बाएँ कंधे तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: kandhe ki haddi ki taklif baen kandhe tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, shoulder, right, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades into your right shoulder.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ दाएँ कंधे तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: kandhe ki haddi ki taklif daen kandhe tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, shoulder, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades into your shoulder.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ कंधे की तरफ फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: kandhe ki haddi ki taklif kandhe ki taraf failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, scapulae, symptoms extend, stomach, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your shoulder blades down to your stomach.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी की तकलीफ पेट (आमाशय) तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: kandhe ki haddi ki taklif pet (amaashay) tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms that start in the middle of your back and spread to other areas.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ दूसरी जगह फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif dusri jagah failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, downward
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back downward through your body.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ नीचे की तरफ फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif neeche ki taraf failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, eyes, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back up to your eyes.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ आँखों तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif aankho tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, groins, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back down into your groin area.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ कमर/जांघ के जोड़ (ग्रोइन) तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif kamar/jangah ke jod (groin) tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, head, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back up to your head.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ सिर तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif sir tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, hypochondria
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back around to the area under your ribs.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ पसलियों के नीचे तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif pasliyom ke neeche tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, hypochondria, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back around to the area under your ribs.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ पसलियों के नीचे की तरफ फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif pasliyom ke neeche ki taraf failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, hypochondria, to, lumbar region
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back around to the area under your ribs and into your lower back.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ पसलियों के नीचे से कमर के हिस्से तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif pasliyom ke neeche se kamar ke hisse tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, hypochondria, to, right side
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back around to the area under your right ribs.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ पसलियों के दाईं तरफ नीचे तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif pasliyom ke dain taraf neeche tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, legs, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back down into your legs.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ टाँगों तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif tangom tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, occiput, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back up to the back of your head (base of the skull).
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ सिर के पीछे (ओसिपुट) तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: pith ke beech ke hisse ki taklif sir ke piche (ociput) tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, temples, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back up to your temples.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ कनपटी तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Peeth ke beech ke hisse ki taklif kanpti tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, thighs, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back down into your thighs.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ जाँघों तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Peeth ke beech ke hisse ki taklif jangho tak failti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, dorsal region, symptoms extend, vertex, to
Comes with other symptoms.en: Symptoms spread from your mid-back up to the top of your head.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच के हिस्से की तकलीफ सिर के ऊपरी हिस्से तक फैलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Peeth ke beech ke hisse ki taklif sir ke upri hisse tak failti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Your back symptoms get worse after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad peeth ki taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Your back symptoms get worse from eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाने से पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khane se peeth ki taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Your back symptoms get worse before eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने से पहले पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane se pehle peeth ki taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Your back symptoms get worse while you are eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay peeth ki taklif badh jati hai.

General.en: The muscles at the back of your neck look or feel wasted or thinned out.
General.hi: गर्दन की माँसपेशियाँ कमज़ोर और पतली हो गई हैं।
General.roman: Gardan ki manspeshiyan kamzor aur patli ho gayi hain.

General.path: Back, emaciation, dorsal region, scapular muscles
General.en: The muscles around your shoulder blades look or feel wasted or thinned out.
General.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में कंधे के पास की माँसपेशियाँ कमज़ोर और पतली हो गई हैं।
General.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse me kandhe ke pass ki manspeshiyan kamzor aur patli ho gayi hain.

General.en: The muscles of your lower back look or feel wasted or thinned out.
General.hi: कमर के हिस्से की माँसपेशियाँ कमज़ोर और पतली हो गई हैं।
General.roman: Kamar ke hisse ki manspeshiyan kamzor aur patli ho gayi hain.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: Your back symptoms are brought on or triggered by an emotional upset.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: भावनात्मक उथल-पुथल से पीठ की तकलीफ होती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: bhavnatmak uthal-puthal se peeth ki taklif hoti hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: Your back symptoms get worse from an emotional upset.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: भावनात्मक उथल-पुथल से पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: bhavnatmak uthal-puthal se peeth ki taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: Your back symptoms get worse when you are angry.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: गुस्सा होने से पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: gussa hone se peeth ki taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: Your back symptoms get worse when you are excited or worked up.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: उत्तेजना या घबराहट से पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: uttejana ya ghabrahut se peeth ki taklif badh jati hai.

Gas & digestion.en: Your back symptom gets better after you burp or belch.
Gas & digestion.hi: डकार आने के बाद पीठ की तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
Gas & digestion.roman: dakar aane ke baad peeth ki taklif kam ho jati hai.

Gas & digestion.en: Your back symptom gets worse while you are burping or belching.
Gas & digestion.hi: डकार आते समय पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Gas & digestion.roman: dakar ate samay peeth ki taklif badh jati hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are acne spots or pimples on your back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर मुँहासे (एक्ने) निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeth par munhase nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are acne spots or pimples on the back of your neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन पर मुँहासे (एक्ने) निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: gardan par munhase nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The skin rash or eruption on your back causes a biting or stinging sensation.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर दाने निकले हैं जिनमें काटने जैसी खुजली होती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeth par dane nikle hain jinmein katne jaisi khujli hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are large flat red or discoloured blotches on the skin of your back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर बड़े लाल धब्बे (ब्लॉचेस) निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeth par bade lal dhabbbe nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are boils on your back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर फोड़े निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeth par phohe nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are blood-filled boils on your back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर खून वाले फोड़े (ब्लड बॉयल्स) निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeth par khun vale phohe nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are boils on the back of your neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन पर फोड़े निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: gardan par phohe nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Boils appearing on the upper-middle part of the back (the area between the shoulders and waist).
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के ऊपरी हिस्से (पृष्ठ भाग) में फोड़े-फुंसी निकलती हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeth ke upri hisse mein phohe-phunsi nikhlti hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, boils, dorsal region, scapulae
Skin/tissue changes.en: Boils appearing on the upper back around the shoulder blades.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कंधे की हड्डियों (स्कैपुला) के आसपास पीठ पर फोड़े निकलते हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: kandhe ki haddi ke aaspass peeth par phohe nikhlte hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, boils, dorsal region, scapulae, left
Skin/tissue changes.en: A boil appearing on the upper back around the left shoulder blade.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: बाईं कंधे की हड्डी के पास पीठ पर फोड़े निकलते हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: bayin kandhe ki haddi ke paas peeṭh par phodе nikaltе hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Boils on the back that appear in clusters or groups.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर फोड़े गुच्छों में (एक साथ कई) निकलते हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeṭh par phodе guchhon mein (ek saath kayi) nikaltе hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Boils appearing in the lower back area.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कमर के हिस्से (पीठ के निचले भाग) में फोड़े निकलते हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: kamar ke hisse (peeṭh ke niche bhag) mein phodе nikaltе hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Boils appearing on the tailbone area.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ की त्रिकास्थि (रीढ़ की हड्डी के सबसे निचले चौड़े हिस्से) पर फोड़े निकलते हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeṭh ki trikasthi (riddh ki haddi ke sabse niche chhode hisse) par phodе nikaltе hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Boils appearing on the back between the shoulder blades.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: दोनों कंधों के बीच पीठ पर फोड़े निकलते हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: donon kandhe ke beech peeṭh par phodе nikaltе hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption on the back that has a burning feeling.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर जो दाने या चकत्ते हैं, उनमें जलन होती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeṭh par jo danе ya chakattе hain, unhmein jalan hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A burning feeling in a skin eruption on the back that comes on after scratching it.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर खुजलाने के बाद दानों में जलन होने लगती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeṭh par khujlane ke baad danon mein jalan hone lagti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A large, deep, painful skin infection (carbuncle) on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर बड़ा और गहरा फोड़ा (कार्बंकल) निकला है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeṭh par bada aur ghra phodа (carbuncle) nikla hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A large, deep, painful skin infection (carbuncle) on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के हिस्से में बड़ा और गहरा फोड़ा (कार्बंकल) निकला है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: gardan ke hisse mein bada aur ghra phodа (carbuncle) nikla hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A large, deep, painful skin infection (carbuncle) on the upper-middle part of the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के ऊपरी हिस्से में बड़ा और गहरा फोड़ा (कार्बंकल) निकला है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeṭh ke upri hisse mein bada aur ghra phodа (carbuncle) nikla hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से में दाने या चकत्ते निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: gardan ke pichle hisse mein danе ya chakattе nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, cervical region, margins of hair
Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption along the hairline at the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन पर जहाँ से बाल शुरू होते हैं, उस किनारे पर दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: gardan par jahan se bal shuru hotе hain, us kinare par danе nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A wet or weeping skin eruption on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से में दाने निकले हैं जिनसे रिसाव (नमी) होती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: gardan ke pichle hisse mein danе nikle hain jinse risav (nami) hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption at the very base of the spine (tailbone area).
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ की सबसे निचली हड्डी (टेलबोन) पर दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeṭh ki sabse nichi haddi (tailbone) par danе nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Crusted or scabbed skin eruptions on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर दानों पर पपड़ी (खुरंड) जम जाती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeṭh par danon par papdi (khurand) jam jati hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, dorsal region, shoulders, between
Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption on the back between the shoulder blades.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: दोनों कंधों के बीच पीठ पर दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: donon kandhe ke beech peeṭh par danе nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, dry on cervical region, peeling off in fine mealy scales
Skin/tissue changes.en: Dry skin eruption on the back of the neck that peels off in fine, powdery flakes.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से में सूखे दाने हैं जिनसे महीन आटे जैसी परतें उखड़ती हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: gardan ke pichle hisse mein sukhe danе hain jinse mhin aate jaisi parten ukhṛti hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Eczema appearing on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर एक्जिमा (खुजली वाले, रिसाव करने वाले दाने) हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeṭh par eczema (khujli wale, risav karne wale danе) hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Reddening of the skin (like a flush or redness) on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से की त्वचा लाल हो गई है (लालिमा/एरिथेमा)।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: gardan ke pichle hisse ki tvcha lal ho gai hai (lalima/erithema).

Skin/tissue changes.en: A fine or delicate skin eruption on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर बहुत बारीक और छोटे-छोटे दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: peeṭh par bahut barik aur chhote-chhote danе nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption on the back that looks like fish scales.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर दाने मछली की शल्कों जैसी परतदार त्वचा के साथ निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par dane machhli ki shalkyon jaisi partdar tvachha ke saath nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption on the back that looks like flea bites.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर पिस्सू के काटने जैसे छोटे-छोटे लाल दाने हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par pissu ke kaatne jaisa chhote-chhote lal dane hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, fungus growth on neck
Skin/tissue changes.en: A fungal growth or fungus-like eruption appearing on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन पर फंगस (फफूंद) की वजह से दाने या चकत्ते हो गए हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan par fungus ki wajah se dane ya chakatte ho gaye hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A herpes-type skin eruption (blistering rash) on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर हर्पीज़ के छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par herpes ke chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A herpes-type blistering rash on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से में हर्पीज़ के छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse mein herpes ke chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, herpes, cervical region, itching
Skin/tissue changes.en: An itching herpes-type blistering rash on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से में हर्पीज़ के छाले हैं और बहुत खुजली होती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse mein herpes ke chhale hain aur bahut khujli hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, herpes, cervical region, moist
Skin/tissue changes.en: A wet or weeping herpes-type blistering rash on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से में हर्पीज़ के गीले (रिसाव करने वाले) छाले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse mein herpes ke gile chhale hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A herpes-type blistering rash on the upper-middle part of the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के ऊपरी हिस्से में हर्पीज़ के छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth ke upri hisse mein herpes ke chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, herpes, dorsal region, dry
Skin/tissue changes.en: A dry herpes-type blistering rash on the upper-middle part of the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के ऊपरी हिस्से में हर्पीज़ के सूखे छाले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth ke upri hisse mein herpes ke sukhe chhale hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A shingles rash (herpes zoster) on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर जलन के साथ एक पट्टी की तरह हर्पीज़ ज़ोस्टर (दाद) के छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par jalan ke saath ek patti ki tarah herpes zoster ke chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: An impetigo skin eruption on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर इम्पेटिगो (पपड़ीदार, संक्रमित दाने) निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par impetigo nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption on the back that feels similar to scabies or an intense itch-rash.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर खाज-खुजली जैसे दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par khaj-khujli jaisa dane nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption on the back that itches.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर दानों में खुजली होती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par danon mein khujli hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: An itching skin eruption at the tailbone area.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ की सबसे निचली हड्डी (टेलबोन) के पास दानों में खुजली होती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth ki sabse nichli haddi ke paas danon mein khujli hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption on the back that itches in the evening.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के दानों में शाम के समय खुजली होती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth ke danon mein sham ke samay khujli hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, itching, in evening, and night
Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption on the back that itches in the evening and at night.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के दानों में शाम और रात दोनों समय खुजली होती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth ke danon mein sham aur raat donon samay khujli hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, itching, in evening, on going to bed
Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption on the back that itches in the evening when getting into bed.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के दानों में शाम को बिस्तर पर जाते समय खुजली होती है।

Skin/tissue changes.en: Psoriasis appearing on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर सोरायसिस (चकत्ते वाली खाल की बीमारी) है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par psoriasis chakte vale khaal ki beemari hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Psoriasis on the back appearing in patches.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर सोरायसिस के धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par psoriasis ke dhabbe hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, psoriasis, patches, cervical region
Skin/tissue changes.en: Psoriasis in patches on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर सोरायसिस के धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par psoriasis ke dhabbe hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Purple pinpoint bleeding spots (purpura) on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर नीले-बैंगनी रंग के दाने या धब्बे निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par nile-baingni rang ke dane ya dhabbe nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Pustules (pus-filled spots) appearing on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर मवाद भरे दाने (पस्ट्यूल) निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par mavaad bhare dane pustule nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, pustules, black points, with
Skin/tissue changes.en: Pustules on the back that have black points or blackheads at their centre.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर मवाद भरे दानों के बीच काले बिंदु भी दिखते हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par mavaad bhare danon ke beech kale bindu bhi dikte hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Pustules (pus-filled spots) appearing on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर मवाद भरे दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par mavaad bhare dane nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, pustules, cervical region, like cow-pox
Skin/tissue changes.en: Pustules on the back of the neck that look similar to cow-pox sores.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर गाय की चेचक जैसे मवाद भरे दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par gai ki chechak jaise mavaad bhare dane nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Pustules (pus-filled spots) appearing in the lower back area.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के कमर वाले हिस्से पर मवाद भरे दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith ke kamar wale hisse par mawad bhare dane nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Painful pustules (pus-filled spots) on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर मवाद भरे दाने निकले हैं जो दर्द करते हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith par mawad bhare dane nikle hain jo dard karte hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Pustules (pus-filled spots) on the back that are sensitive or tender.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर मवाद भरे दाने निकले हैं जो छूने पर बहुत तकलीफ देते हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith par mawad bhare dane nikle hain jo chhune par bahut taklif dete hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Pustules on the back that look similar to smallpox sores.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर चेचक जैसे मवाद भरे दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith par chechak jaise mawad bhare dane nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A rash appearing on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर लाल रंग के चकत्ते या रैश निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith par lal rang ke chaknatte ya rash nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A rash appearing on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर रैश निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par rash nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, rash, cervical region, erysipelatous
Skin/tissue changes.en: An erysipelas-type rash (hot, red, spreading rash) on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर लाल सूजन वाले चकत्ते (एरिसिपेलस जैसे) निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par lal sujan wale chaknatte (erisipelas jaise) nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, rash, cervical region, heat
Skin/tissue changes.en: A rash on the back of the neck that feels hot.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर गर्मी के साथ रैश निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par garmi ke saath rash nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, rash, cervical region, itching
Skin/tissue changes.en: An itching rash on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर खुजली वाले रैश निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par khujli wale rash nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, rash, cervical region, miliary
Skin/tissue changes.en: A fine, tiny, millet-seed-like rash on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर बारीक दानेदार रैश निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par bareek danedaar rash nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, rash, cervical region, purple
Skin/tissue changes.en: A purple-coloured rash on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर बैंगनी रंग के चकत्ते निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par baingani rang ke chaknatte nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, rash, cervical region, red
Skin/tissue changes.en: A red rash on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर लाल रंग के चकत्ते निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par lal rang ke chaknatte nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A rash appearing in the lower back area.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के कमर वाले हिस्से पर रैश निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith ke kamar wale hisse par rash nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A red skin eruption on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर लाल रंग के दाने या चकत्ते निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith par lal rang ke dane ya chaknatte nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption over the sacral area (just above the tailbone).
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के नितंब के ऊपर वाले (सेक्रल) हिस्से पर दाने निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith ke nitamb ke upar wale (sacral) hisse par dane nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Scabs forming on a skin eruption on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर पपड़ी (खुरंड) जम गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith par papdi (khurund) jam gayi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: Bloody scabs forming on a skin eruption on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर खून वाली पपड़ी जमी हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith par khoon wali papdi jami hui hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, scabs, bloody, cervical region
Skin/tissue changes.en: Bloody scabs forming on a skin eruption on the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर खून वाली पपड़ी जमी हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par khoon wali papdi jami hui hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are bloody, crusty scabs on the skin over the tailbone area.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पूँछ की हड्डी (कोक्सिक्स) के पास खून वाली पपड़ी जमी हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Poonch ki haddi (coccyx) ke paas khoon wali papdi jami hui hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, scabs, bloody, sacral region
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are bloody, crusty scabs on the skin over the sacral (lower back, above the tailbone) area.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ के नितंब के ऊपर वाले हिस्से पर खून वाली पपड़ी जमी हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pith ke nitamb ke upar wale hisse par khoon wali papdi jami hui hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The skin on the back has flaky, scaly patches.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर खाल उतर रही है या परतें निकल रही हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par khaal utar rahi hai ya parten nikal rahi hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, scales, cervical region, white
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are white, flaky, scaly patches on the skin at the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर सफेद रंग की परतें (खाल) उतर रही हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par safed rang ki parten khaal utar rahi hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are flaky, scaly patches on the skin over the right shoulder blade.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: दाईं कंधे की हड्डी (स्कैपुला) पर परतें उतर रही हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Daain kandhe ki haddi scapula par parten utar rahi hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is a stinging or smarting sensation from a skin eruption on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर दाने निकले हैं जिनमें जलन और चुभन होती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par dane nikle hain jinmein jalan aur chubhan hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small raised bumps (like tubercles or firm nodules) on the skin of the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर छोटी-छोटी कठोर गाँठें (ट्यूबरकल) निकली हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par chhoti-chhoti kathor gaanthen tubarcle nikli hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small raised firm bumps on the skin at the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर छोटी-छोटी कठोर गाँठें निकली हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par chhoti-chhoti kathor gaanthen nikli hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is a hive-like rash (raised, itchy welts) on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर पित्ती (अर्टिकेरिया) निकली हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par pitti urticaria nikli hui hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A hive-like rash (raised, itchy welts) appears on the back after scratching.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर खुजलाने के बाद पित्ती निकल आती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par khujlane ke baad pitti nikal aati hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small fluid-filled blisters on the skin of the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर पानी भरे छाले (ब्लिस्टर) निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par pani bhare chhale blister nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small fluid-filled blisters on the skin at the back of the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par pani bhare chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, vesicles, dorsal region, scapulae
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small fluid-filled blisters on the skin over the shoulder blades (upper back).
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कंधे की हड्डियों (स्कैपुला) के आसपास पीठ के ऊपरी हिस्से पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kandhe ki haddiyon scapula ke aaspas peeth ke uparI hisse par pani bhare chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, vesicles, evening, itching when undressing
Skin/tissue changes.en: In the evening, small fluid-filled blisters appear on the back and itch when undressing.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: शाम को कपड़े उतारते वक्त पीठ पर पानी भरे छालों में खुजली होती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Shaam ko kapde utarte waqt peeth par pani bhare chhalon mein khujli hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, vesicles, on a red elevated base
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small fluid-filled blisters on the back that sit on a raised, red base.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर पानी भरे छाले हैं जो लाल उभरी हुई जगह पर बने हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par pani bhare chhale hain jo lal ubhri hui jagah par bane hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small fluid-filled blisters on or around the shoulder blades.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कंधे की हड्डियों (स्कैपुला) पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kandhe ki haddiyon scapula par pani bhare chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small fluid-filled blisters on the skin of the shoulders.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: कंधों पर पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Kandhon par pani bhare chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, vesicles, shoulders, between the
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small fluid-filled blisters on the skin between the shoulder blades.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: दोनों कंधों के बीच पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Donon kandhon ke beech pani bhare chhale nikle hain.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, eruptions, vesicles, shoulders, between the, surrounded by red areola
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small fluid-filled blisters between the shoulder blades, each surrounded by a red ring.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: दोनों कंधों के बीच पानी भरे छाले निकले हैं जिनके चारों तरफ लाल घेरा है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Donon kandhon ke beech pani bhare chhale nikle hain jinke charon taraf lal ghera hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A skin eruption or rash on the back gets worse when the body becomes warm.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्मी लगने पर या गर्म होने पर पीठ पर दाने और भी बढ़ जाते हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Garmi lagne par ya garm hone par peeth par dane aur bhi badh jate hain.

Inflammation.en: There is a hot, red, inflamed skin condition (like erysipelas) spreading across the shoulders.
Inflammation.hi: कंधों पर लाल, जलन भरी सूजन (एरिसिपेलस) फैली हुई है।
Inflammation.roman: Kandhon par lal jalan bhari sujan erysipelas faili hui hai.

Inflammation.en: There is a hot, red, inflamed skin condition (like erysipelas) affecting the back of the neck.
Inflammation.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से पर लाल, जलन भरी सूजन (एरिसिपेलस) है।
Inflammation.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse par laal, jalan bhari sujan (erysipelas) hai.

Inflammation.path: Back, erysipelas, cervical region, extending to face
Inflammation.en: There is a hot, red, inflamed skin condition (like erysipelas) at the back of the neck that spreads toward the face.
Inflammation.hi: गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से की लाल जलन भरी सूजन मुँह की तरफ फैल रही है।
Inflammation.roman: Gardan ke pichle hisse ki laal jalan bhari sujan munh ki taraf fail rahi hai.

Inflammation.en: There is a hot, red, inflamed skin condition (like erysipelas) affecting the lower back.
Inflammation.hi: पीठ के कमर वाले हिस्से पर लाल, जलन भरी सूजन (एरिसिपेलस) है।
Inflammation.roman: Peeth ke kamar wale hisse par laal, jalan bhari sujan (erysipelas) hai.

Gas & digestion.path: Back, flatus, after discharge of, agg.
Gas & digestion.en: Back discomfort gets worse after passing wind.
Gas & digestion.hi: गैस निकलने के बाद पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Gas & digestion.roman: Gas nikalne ke baad peeth ki taklif badh jati hai.

Gas & digestion.en: Back discomfort gets better after passing wind.
Gas & digestion.hi: गैस निकलने पर पीठ की तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
Gas & digestion.roman: Gas nikalne par peeth ki taklif kam ho jati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, fluttering, beginning in sacrum and gradually rising to occiput
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a fluttering sensation that starts at the tailbone and gradually rises up to the back of the head.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के निचले हिस्से (कोक्सिक्स/सेक्रम) से फड़फड़ाहट शुरू होकर धीरे-धीरे सिर के पिछले हिस्से तक चढ़ती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth ke neeche hisse (coccyx/sacrum) se phadfadahat shuru hokar dhire-dhire sir ke pichle hisse tak chadti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, fluttering, between shoulders
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a fluttering sensation felt between the shoulder blades.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दोनों कंधों के बीच फड़फड़ाहट महसूस होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Donon kando ke beech phadfadahat mehsus hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, fluttering, lumbar region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a fluttering sensation in the lower back.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के कमर वाले हिस्से में फड़फड़ाहट महसूस होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth ke kamar wale hisse mein phadfadahat mehsus hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, foreign body, sensation of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a feeling as if something foreign is stuck in the back.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ में कुछ अटका हुआ या फँसा हुआ महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth mein kuch atka hua ya fansa hua mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, foreign body, sensation of, dorsal region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a feeling as if something foreign is stuck in the upper back area.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के ऊपरी हिस्से में कुछ अटका हुआ महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth ke uparI hisse mein kuch atka hua mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, foreign body, sensation of, dorsal region, scapulae
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a feeling as if something foreign is lodged around the shoulder blades.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कंधे की हड्डियों (स्कैपुला) के आसपास कुछ अटका हुआ महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kandhe ki haddiyon (scapula) ke aaspass kuch atka hua mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, foreign body, sensation of, dorsal region, scapulae, between
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a feeling as if something foreign is lodged between the shoulder blades.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दोनों कंधे की हड्डियों के बीच कुछ अटका हुआ महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Donon kandhe ki haddiyon ke beech kuch atka hua mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, foreign body, sensation of, dorsal region, scapulae, left
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a feeling as if something foreign is lodged under or around the left shoulder blade.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: बाईं कंधे की हड्डी (स्कैपुला) में कुछ अटका हुआ महसूस होता है।

Linked to posture/position.en: A feeling of numbness at the tailbone that comes on while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठते समय पूँछ की हड्डी में सुन्नपन महसूस होता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithte samay punchh ki haddi mein sunnpan mehsus hota hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Back, numbness, part lain on
Linked to posture/position.en: Numbness develops in whichever part of the back has been lain on.
Linked to posture/position.hi: जिस करवट लेटा/लेटी हूँ, उस हिस्से में सुन्नपन महसूस होता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Jis karwat leta hun us hisse mein sunnpan mehsus hota hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Back, numbness, sacrum, while sitting
Linked to posture/position.en: A feeling of numbness in the sacrum that comes on while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठते समय कमर की त्रिकास्थि में सुन्नपन महसूस होता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithte samay kamar ki trikasthi mein sunnapan mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Back, numbness, lumbar region, loss of sensation, evening
Linked to time of day.en: A complete loss of feeling in the lower back that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को कमर के हिस्से में सुन्नपन है और वहाँ कुछ भी महसूस नहीं होता।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko kamar ke hisse mein sunnpan hai aur wahan kuch bhi mehsus nahi hota.

Linked to time of day.path: Back, numbness, lumbar region, loss of sensation, morning, on rising
Linked to time of day.en: A complete loss of feeling in the lower back that is present in the morning when getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने पर कमर के हिस्से में सुन्नपन और कुछ महसूस न होने की तकलीफ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne par kamar ke hisse mein sunnpan aur kuch mehsus na hone ki taklif hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, numbness, lumbar region, loss of sensation, extending to lower limbs
Comes with other symptoms.en: A complete loss of feeling in the lower back that spreads down into the legs.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कमर के हिस्से में सुन्नपन है और यह सुन्नपन टाँगों तक फैल जाता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kamar ke hisse mein sunnpan hai aur ye sunnpan tangon tak fail jata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, numbness, sacrum, lower limbs, and
Comes with other symptoms.en: A feeling of numbness in the sacrum that also affects the legs.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कमर की त्रिकास्थि और टाँगों में एक साथ सुन्नपन महसूस होता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kamar ki trikasthi aur tangnon mein ek saath sunnapan mehsoos hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, aching
Type of pain.en: A dull, aching pain in the back.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में दर्द होता है जो टीस मारता रहता है।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth mein dard hota hai jo tis marta rehta hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, aching, dull pain
Type of pain.en: A dull, aching pain in the back.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में हल्का, भारी-सा दर्द रहता है।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth mein halka, bhari-sa dard rehta hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, aching, dull pain, bar, as from a
Type of pain.en: A dull, aching back pain that feels as if a bar or rod is pressing across the back.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में ऐसा हल्का, भारी-सा दर्द है जैसे कोई छड़ी या बार अड़ी हो।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth mein aisa halka, bhari-sa dard hai jaise koi chhdi ya bar adhi ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, biting
Type of pain.en: A biting sensation of pain in the back.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में काटने या चुभने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Pith mein katne ya chubhne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, blow as of, dorsal region, scapulae
Type of pain.en: A pain in the upper back at the shoulder blades that feels like a sudden blow or impact.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में कंधे की हड्डी (पंख) के पास ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे किसी ने चोट मारी हो।
Type of pain.roman: Pith ke beech wale hisse mein kandhe ki haddi (pankh) ke pas aisa dard hota hai jaise kisine chot mari ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, blow as of, lumbar region
Type of pain.en: A pain in the lower back that feels like a sudden blow or impact.
Type of pain.hi: कमर में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे किसी ने मुक्का मारा हो।
Type of pain.roman: Kamar mein aisa dard hota hai jaise kisine mukka mara ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, blow as of, sacrum and coccyx
Type of pain.en: A pain in the tailbone and sacrum area that feels like a sudden blow or impact.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ के नीचे (कमर की हड्डी और टेलबोन) में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे किसी ने चोट मारी हो।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth ke neeche (kamar ki haddi aur tailbone) mein aisa dard hota hai jaise kisine chot mari ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, blow as of, vertebrae
Type of pain.en: A pain along the spine's vertebrae that feels like a sudden blow or impact.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ की रीढ़ की हड्डियों में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे किसी ने चोट मारी हो।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth ki reedh ki haddiyon mein aisa dard hota hai jaise kisine chot mari ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling type of pain in the back.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में खोदने या कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth mein khodne ya kurede jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, as with a gimlet
Type of pain.en: A boring pain in the back that feels like a gimlet or sharp tool drilling into it.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे कोई बरमे (ड्रिल) से खोद रहा हो।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth mein aisa dard hota hai jaise koi barme (drill) se khod raha ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, cervical region
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain in the neck area of the back.
Type of pain.hi: गर्दन में खोदने या कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Gardan mein khodne ya kurede jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain in the upper back.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से (छाती के पीछे) में खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse (chhati ke peeche) mein khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain at the shoulder blades in the upper back.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में कंधे की हड्डी (पंख) के पास खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse mein kandhe ki haddi (pankh) ke paas khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, between
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain between the shoulder blades.
Type of pain.hi: दोनों कंधे की हड्डियों (पंखों) के बीच में खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Donon kandhe ki haddiyon (pankhon) ke beech mein khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, deep inhalation, on
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain at the shoulder blades that gets worse when taking a deep breath in.
Type of pain.hi: गहरी सांस लेने पर कंधे की हड्डी (पंख) के पास खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Gahri sans lene par kandhe ki haddi (pankh) ke paas khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, left
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain at the left shoulder blade.
Type of pain.hi: बाईं कंधे की हड्डी (पंख) के पास खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Bain kandhe ki haddi (pankh) ke paas khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, left, tip of
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain at the tip of the left shoulder blade.
Type of pain.hi: बाईं कंधे की हड्डी (पंख) की नोक पर खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Bain kandhe ki haddi (pankh) ki nok par khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, motion amel.
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain at the shoulder blades that gets better with movement.
Type of pain.hi: हिलने-डुलने पर कंधे की हड्डी (पंख) के पास का खोदने जैसा दर्द कम हो जाता है।
Type of pain.roman: Hilne-dulne par kandhe ki haddi (pankh) ke paas ka khodne jaisa dard kam ho jata hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, right
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain at the right shoulder blade.
Type of pain.hi: दाईं कंधे की हड्डी (पंख) के पास खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Dain kandhe ki haddi (pankh) ke paas khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, right, to front of chest
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain at the right shoulder blade that spreads through to the front of the chest.
Type of pain.hi: दाईं कंधे की हड्डी (पंख) के पास से खोदने जैसा दर्द सीने के आगे तक जाता है।
Type of pain.roman: Dain kandhe ki haddi (pankh) ke paas se khodne jaisa dard sene ke aage tak jata hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, shoulders
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain at the shoulder blades and shoulders.
Type of pain.hi: कंधे की हड्डियों (पंखों) और कंधों के पास खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kandhe ki haddiyon (pankhon) aur kandhon ke paas khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, shoulders, between
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain between the shoulder blades and shoulders.
Type of pain.hi: दोनों कंधों के बीच में खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Donon kandhon ke beech mein khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, shoulders, between, rest, during
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain between the shoulder blades and shoulders that occurs while resting.
Type of pain.hi: आराम करते समय दोनों कंधों के बीच में खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Aaram karte samay donon kandhon ke beech mein khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, scapulae, spine
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain along the spine in the upper back.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में रीढ़ की हड्डी के पास खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse mein reedh ki haddi ke paas khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, dorsal region, vertebrae
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain in the vertebrae of the upper back.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में कशेरुका हड्डियों में खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse mein kasheruka haddiyon mein khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, extending, shoulder, right
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain in the back that spreads through to the right shoulder.
Type of pain.hi: दाएं कंधे तक फैलने वाला खोदने जैसा दर्द पीठ में होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Daaye kandhe tak failne wala khodne jaisa dard peeth mein hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, in spots
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain in the back that occurs in isolated spots.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में जगह-जगह अलग-अलग बिंदुओं पर खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth mein jagah-jagah alag-alag binduon par khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, lumbar region
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain in the lower back.
Type of pain.hi: कमर में खोदने या कुरेदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kamar mein khodne ya kuredne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, lumbar region, left
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain in the left side of the lower back.
Type of pain.hi: कमर के बाईं तरफ खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kamar ke bayin taraf khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, lumbar region, right
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain in the right side of the lower back.
Type of pain.hi: कमर के दाईं तरफ खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Kamar ke dayin taraf khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, boring, sacral region
Type of pain.en: A boring, drilling pain in the sacrum area at the base of the spine.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ के नीचे (कूल्हे की हड्डी के पास) में खोदने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth ke neeche (kulhe ki haddi ke paas) mein khodne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, break
Type of pain.en: A pain in the back that feels like something is about to break.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे पीठ टूट जाएगी।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth mein aisa dard hota hai jaise peeth toot jayegi.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, break, as though the back would
Type of pain.en: A pain in the back with a feeling as though the back itself is about to break.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में ऐसा लगता है जैसे पीठ टूट जाएगी।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth mein aisa lagta hai jaise peeth toot jayegi.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, break, as though the back would, cervical region
Type of pain.en: A pain in the neck area of the back with a feeling as though it is about to break.
Type of pain.hi: गर्दन में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वो टूट जाएगी।
Type of pain.roman: Gardan mein aisa lagta hai jaise wo toot jayegi.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, break, as though the back would, dorsal region
Type of pain.en: A pain in the upper back with a feeling as though it is about to break.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वो टूट जाएगी।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse mein aisa lagta hai jaise wo toot jayegi.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, break, as though the back would, lumbar region
Type of pain.en: A pain in the lower back with a feeling as though it is about to break.
Type of pain.hi: कमर में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वो टूट जाएगी।
Type of pain.roman: Kamar mein aisa lagta hai jaise wo toot jayegi.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, break, as though the back would, lumbar region, motion amel.
Type of pain.en: A pain in the lower back that feels as though it is about to break, and gets better with movement.
Type of pain.hi: हिलने-डुलने से कमर का यह टूटने जैसा दर्द कम हो जाता है।
Type of pain.roman: Hilne-dulne se kamar ka yeh tootne jaisa dard kam ho jata hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, break, as though the back would, lumbar region, stooping, when
Type of pain.en: A pain in the lower back that feels as though it is about to break, and gets worse when bending forward.
Type of pain.hi: झुकने पर कमर में टूटने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Jhukne par kamar mein tootne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, break, as though the back would, sacrum
Type of pain.en: A pain in the sacrum at the base of the spine that feels as though it is about to break.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ के नीचे (कूल्हे की हड्डी) में टूटने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth ke neeche (kulhe ki haddi) mein tootne jaisa dard hota hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, broken
Type of pain.en: A pain in the back that feels as though something is broken.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे पीठ टूटी हुई हो।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth mein aisa dard hota hai jaise peeth tooti hui ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, broken, as if
Type of pain.en: A pain in the back that feels as if something is broken.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ में ऐसा लगता है जैसे पीठ टूटी हुई हो।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth mein aisa lagta hai jaise peeth tooti hui ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, broken, as if, cervical region
Type of pain.en: A pain in the neck area of the back that feels as if something is broken.
Type of pain.hi: गर्दन में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वो टूटी हुई हो।
Type of pain.roman: Gardan mein aisa lagta hai jaise wo tooti hui ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, broken, as if, cervical region, as if it would break in two; left side agg. when riding in a carriage
Type of pain.en: A pain in the neck area of the back that feels as if it would break in two, with the left side getting worse when riding in a vehicle.
Type of pain.hi: गर्दन में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वो बीच से टूट जाएगी; बाईं तरफ यह दर्द गाड़ी में बैठने पर बढ़ जाता है।
Type of pain.roman: Gardan mein aisa lagta hai jaise wo beech se toot jaegi; bain taraf ye dard gaadi mein baithne par badh jata hai.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, broken, as if, coccyx
Type of pain.en: A pain in the tailbone (coccyx) that feels as if it is broken.
Type of pain.hi: टेलबोन में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वो टूटी हुई हो।
Type of pain.roman: Tailbone mein aisa lagta hai jaise wo tooti hui ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, broken, as if, dorsal region
Type of pain.en: A pain in the upper back that feels as if something is broken.
Type of pain.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वो टूटी हुई हो।
Type of pain.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse mein aisa lagta hai jaise wo tooti hui ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, broken, as if, lumbar region
Type of pain.en: A pain in the lower back that feels as if something is broken.
Type of pain.hi: कमर में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वो टूटी हुई हो।
Type of pain.roman: Kamar mein aisa lagta hai jaise wo tooti hui ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, broken, as if, lumbar region, knocked away, sensation as if
Type of pain.en: A pain in the lower back that feels as if the support has been knocked away from underneath it.
Type of pain.hi: कमर में ऐसा लगता है जैसे कोई हिस्सा अलग हो गया हो या हट गया हो।
Type of pain.roman: Kamar mein aisa lagta hai jaise koi hissa alag ho gaya ho ya hat gaya ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, broken, as if, sacrum
Type of pain.en: A pain in the sacrum at the base of the spine that feels as if it is broken.
Type of pain.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी के सबसे नीचे वाले हिस्से (कूल्हे के ऊपर) में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे हड्डी टूट गई हो।
Type of pain.roman: Reedh ki haddi ke sabse niche wale hisse (kulhe ke upar) mein aisa dard hota hai jaise haddi tut gayi ho.

Type of pain.path: Back, pain, broken, as if, scapulae
Type of pain.en: A pain at the shoulder blades that feels as if they are broken.
Type of pain.hi: कंधे के पीछे की हड्डी (कंधे की पत्ती) में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे हड्डी टूट गई हो।

General.path: Back, pain, aching, dull pain, bed, confines him to
General.en: A dull, aching back pain so severe it keeps you in bed.
General.hi: पीठ में इतना हल्का, भारी-सा दर्द है कि बिस्तर से उठा ही नहीं जाता।
General.roman: Peeth mein itna halka, bhari-sa dard hai ki bistar se utha hi nahi jata.

General.path: Back, pain, aching, dull pain, lumbar region, periodic
General.en: I get dull aching pains in my lower back that come and go regularly.
General.hi: कमर में दर्द बार-बार एक निश्चित समय पर होता है।
General.roman: kamar mein dard baar-baar ek nischit samay par hota hai.

General.en: A dull, aching rheumatic pain in the back.

General.roman: Pith mein gathiya jaisa dard hota hai.

General.en: Back pain that occurs during the fever-free intervals of an illness.
General.hi: बुखार उतरने के बाद (बुखार न होने की अवस्था में) पीठ में दर्द होता है।

General.en: The pain in the back of my neck comes and goes regularly or at regular intervals.

General.roman: Gardan ka dard ek nischit samay par bar-bar aata hai.

General.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the back that spreads or extends to other areas.
General.hi: पीठ में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो किसी दूसरी जगह तक फैलता है।
General.roman: Pith mein khinchaav jaisa dard hota hai jo kisi dusri jagah tak failta hai.

General.en: A drawing (pulling) pain in the back that extends downwards.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, alternating with, hemorrhoids

Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kamar mein dard hota hai jo bawasir ke saath bari-bari se aata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, alternating with, pain in thighs

Comes with other symptoms.en: Pain along the top ridge of the right hip bone that is worse in the morning when sitting down, gets better when standing or walking, and spreads down into the thigh.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: सुबह बैठने पर दाईं कमर की हड्डी की ऊपरी धार पर दर्द बढ़ जाता है, खड़े होने और चलने पर कम होता है, और दर्द जांघ तक फैलता है।

Comes with other symptoms.roman: Trikasthi mein dard hota hai aur saath hī sir ke pichche hisse mein bhī dard hota hai, donon dard barī-barī aate hain.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, sacral region, chill, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: Pain at the base of the spine that comes on during a fever with chills.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने (कँपकँपी) के दौरान त्रिकास्थि (पीठ के सबसे नीचे का हिस्सा) में दर्द होता है।

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, sacral region, dysentery, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: Pain at the base of the spine that occurs along with severe diarrhea or dysentery.

Comes with other symptoms.roman: Peeth mein dard ke saath-saath sans lene mein bhi taklif hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, sore, dorsal region, scapulae, under, between paroxysms of burning

Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kandhe ki haddi ke neeche jalan ke daure ke beech-beech mein dard hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, sore, dorsal region, scapulae, under, wheezing, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: A sore, bruised aching underneath the shoulder blades that comes along with wheezing.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंधे की हड्डी के नीचे दर्द के साथ सांस लेने में घरघराहट भी होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kandhe ki haddi ke neeche dard ke saath sans lene mein gharghrahaat bhi hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, sore, sacral region, paralytic pain in knees on rising from seat
Comes with other symptoms.en: The lower back (sacrum area) feels sore and bruised, and when getting up from a seated position there is a paralytic, weak pain in the knees.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कमर के निचले हिस्से (त्रिकास्थि) में दर्द है और कुर्सी से उठते समय घुटनों में लकवे जैसी कमज़ोरी महसूस होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kamar ke niche hisse (trikasthi) mein dard hai aur kursi se uthte samay ghutno mein lakwe jaisi kamzori mehsus hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, sore, shivering, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: The back feels sore and bruised during episodes of shivering or chills.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: कंपकंपी या ठंड लगने के दौरान पीठ में दर्द और पीड़ा होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kampkampi ya thandi lagne ke dauran pith mein dard aur peeda hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, sore, spine, fever, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: The spine feels sore and bruised during a fever.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बुखार के दौरान रीढ़ की हड्डी में दर्द और पीड़ा होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bukhar ke dauran reedh ki haddi mein dard aur peeda hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, spine, convulsions, after
Comes with other symptoms.en: There is pain along the spine after a convulsion or fit.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दौरे (ऐंठन) के बाद रीढ़ की हड्डी में दर्द होता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Daure (ainthan) ke baad ridh ki haddi mein dard hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, spine, night, with weakness of extremities
Comes with other symptoms.en: There is pain along the spine at night, accompanied by weakness in the arms and legs.
