Comes with other symptoms.roman: Raat ko ridh ki haddi mein dard hota hai aur hath-pairon mein kamzori bhi rehti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, spine, relieving the headache
Comes with other symptoms.en: There is pain along the spine that seems to relieve a headache when it appears.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी का दर्द सिर के दर्द को कम करता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Ridh ki haddi ka dard sir ke dard ko kam karta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, stitching, dorsal region, breathing, arresting
Comes with other symptoms.en: A sharp, stitching pain in the upper back that is so severe it stops you from breathing.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में चुभन जैसा दर्द होता है जिससे साँस रुक जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Pith ke beech wale hisse mein chuban jaisa dard hota hai jisse sans ruk jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, stitching, extending, to hypochondrium, on lying or coughing, amel. by standing or sitting
Comes with other symptoms.en: A sharp, stitching back pain that spreads to under the ribs and gets worse when lying down or coughing but gets better when standing or sitting.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पीठ में चुभन जैसा दर्द होता है जो पसलियों के नीचे तक जाता है — लेटने या खाँसने पर बढ़ता है और खड़े होने या बैठने पर कम हो जाता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Peeth mein chuban jaisa dard hota hai jo pasliyon ke neeche tak jata hai — letne ya khansi par badhta hai aur khade hone ya baithne par kam ho jata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, talking prevented
Comes with other symptoms.en: My back pain is so bad it stops me from talking.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बात करने से पीठ का दर्द इतना बढ़ जाता है कि बोलना मुश्किल हो जाता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Baat karne se pith ka dard itna badh jata hai ki bolna mushkil ho jata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, pain, tearing, cervical region, chill, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: I get a tearing pain in the back of my neck during a chill.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने (कंपकंपी) के दौरान गर्दन में खिंचाव वाला दर्द होता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi lagne ke dauran garden mein khinchaav wala dard hota hai.

Linked to bowel movement.path: Back, pain, aching, dull pain, cervical region, extending, small of back on going to stool
Linked to bowel movement.en: A dull, aching pain in the neck that spreads down to the lower back when having a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच करने जाते समय गर्दन का हल्का, भारी-सा दर्द कमर तक फैल जाता है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch karne jate samay gardan ka halka, bhari-sa dard kamar tak fail jata hai.

Linked to bowel movement.path: Back, pain, aching, dull pain, coccyx, stool, after
Linked to bowel movement.en: A dull, aching pain at the tailbone that comes on after a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच के बाद टेलबोन में हल्का दर्द होता है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch ke baad tailbone mein halka dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, coccyx, riding, as after a long carriage ride
Sensation / feel of the area.en: My tailbone pain feels like I've been on a very long bumpy carriage or vehicle ride.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे लंबे समय तक गाड़ी में सफर करने के बाद टेलबोन में दर्द हो रहा हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise lambe samay tak gaadi mein safar karne ke baad tailbone mein dard ho raha ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, coccyx, sitting, on something sharp, as if
Sensation / feel of the area.en: When sitting, my tailbone feels as if I am sitting on something sharp.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे किसी नुकीली चीज पर बैठा हो, टेलबोन में दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise kisi nukili chiz par baitha ho, tailbone mein dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, crushed
Sensation / feel of the area.en: My back feels as though it has been crushed.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे कुचल दिया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith mein aisa dard hota hai jaise kuchal diya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, crushed, as if
Sensation / feel of the area.en: My back feels as though it has been crushed.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ में ऐसा लगता है जैसे किसी ने कुचल दिया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith mein aisa lagta hai jaise kisine kuchal diya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, crushed, as if, dorsal region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The middle part of my back feels as though it has been crushed.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में ऐसा लगता है जैसे किसी ने कुचल दिया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke beech wale hisse mein aisa lagta hai jaise kisine kuchal diya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, crushed, as if, dorsal region, scapulae
Sensation / feel of the area.en: My shoulder blade area feels as though it has been crushed.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कंधे की हड्डी में ऐसा लगता है जैसे किसी ने कुचल दिया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kandhe ki haddi mein aisa lagta hai jaise kisine kuchal diya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, crushed, as if, lumbar region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: My lower back feels as though it has been crushed.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में ऐसा लगता है जैसे किसी ने कुचल दिया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein aisa lagta hai jaise kisine kuchal diya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, crushed, as if, lumbar region, on motion
Sensation / feel of the area.en: My lower back feels as though it has been crushed whenever I move.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: हिलने-डुलने पर कमर में ऐसा लगता है जैसे किसी ने कुचल दिया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Hilne-dulne par kamar mein aisa lagta hai jaise kisine kuchal diya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, crushed, as if, sacrum
Sensation / feel of the area.en: My sacrum (the triangular bone at the base of my spine, just above the tailbone) feels as though it has been crushed.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: त्रिकास्थि (सेक्रम) में ऐसा लगता है जैसे किसी ने कुचल दिया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Trikasthi mein aisa lagta hai jaise kisine kuchal diya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, cutting, extending up
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cutting pain in the back that travels upward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ में काटने जैसा दर्द होता है जो ऊपर की तरफ फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith mein katne jaisa dard hota hai jo upar ki taraf failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, descends
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A back pain that travels downward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ का दर्द नीचे की ओर उतरता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth ka dard neeche ki or utarta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, dislocated, as if, sacrum, sacro-iliac symphyses as if separated
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pain in the sacrum that feels as if the sacro-iliac joints (where the tailbone meets the hips) have come apart.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ की टेलबोन और कूल्हे की हड्डी के जोड़ में ऐसा लगता है जैसे दोनों हड्डियाँ अलग हो गई हों।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth ki tailbone aur kulhe ki haddi ke jod mein aisa lagta hai jaise donon haddiyaan alag ho gayi hon.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, dorsal region, fall, as from a
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Pain in the middle of the back that feels as though you have had a bad fall.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे कहीं से गिर गए हों।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse mein aisa dard hota hai jaise kahin se gir gaye hon.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, dorsal region, scapulae, deep-seated
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A deep-seated pain felt within the shoulder blade area.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कंधे की चपटी हड्डी में अंदर गहरा दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kandhe ki chapti haddi mein andar gehra dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, dorsal region, scapulae, right, sitting bent double, as if from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is pain in the right shoulder blade area that feels as though you have been sitting hunched over double.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दाईं कंधे की हड्डी में दर्द होता है जैसे दोहरा झुककर बैठने से होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Daain kandhe ki haddi mein dard hota hai jaise dohra jhukkar baithne se hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, dorsal region, scapulae, stooping, as of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a pain in the shoulder blade area of the upper back that feels as if you are bent over stooping.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कंधे की हड्डी में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे झुकने से हो रहा हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kandhe ki haddi mein aisa dard hota hai jaise jhukne se ho raha ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, dorsal region, spine, fall, as from a
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is pain along the spine in the upper back that feels as if you have fallen hard.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच की हड्डी में ऐसा दर्द जैसे ऊपर से गिरे हों।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke beech ki haddi mein aisa dard jaise upar se gire hon.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, dorsal region, spine, stoop, compelling to
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The pain along the spine in the upper back makes you feel compelled to bend over.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच की हड्डी में इतना दर्द होता है कि झुकना पड़ता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth ke beech ki haddi mein itna dard hota hai ki jhukna padta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, dorsal region, weakness, as from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a pain in the upper back (mid-back) that feels like weakness or a giving-out sensation.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच की हड्डी में ऐसा दर्द जैसे कमज़ोरी आ गई हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth ke beech ki haddi mein aisa dard jaise kamzori aa gayi ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, drawing, coccyx, sensation of pulling upwards from tip of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sensation of being pulled upward from the tip of the tailbone.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: टेलबोन की नोक से ऊपर की ओर खिंचाव महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Tailbone ki nok se upar ki or khinchaav mehsoos hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, drawing, dorsal region, scapulae, drawing up and down
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A drawing (pulling) pain between the shoulder blades that moves or pulls both upward and downward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कंधे की हड्डी में खिंचाव जैसा दर्द ऊपर-नीचे की तरफ जाता हुआ महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kandhe ki haddi mein khinchaav jaisa dard upar-neeche ki taraf jata hua mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, gnawing, in small spot
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A gnawing back pain felt in one small concentrated spot.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ में एक छोटी सी जगह पर कुतरने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth mein ek chhoti si jagah par kutrane jaisa dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, fall, as from a
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A lower back pain that feels as though you have fallen hard and injured yourself.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे कहीं से गिर गए हों।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein aisa dard hota hai jaise kahin se gir gaye hon.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, forcing outward, as if
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A lower back pain that feels as if something is pushing outward from the inside.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे अंदर से बाहर की तरफ धकेला जा रहा हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein aisa dard hota hai jaise andar se bahar ki taraf dhakela ja raha ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, paralytic
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A lower back pain that feels like weakness or paralysis in the area.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे ताकत चली गई हो और अंग काम नहीं कर रहा।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein aisa dard hota hai jaise taakat chali gayi ho aur ang kaam nahi kar raha.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, stooping, as after long
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The lower back feels achy and stiff, as if you have been bent over or stooping for a long time.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे बहुत देर तक झुके रहने के बाद कमर में दर्द हो रहा हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise bahut der tak jhuke rehne ke baad kamar mein dard ho raha ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, weakness, as from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The lower back pain feels like a weakness or giving-out sensation.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे वहाँ से ताकत निकल गई हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein aisa dard hota hai jaise wahan se takat nikal gai ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, overlifting, as from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The back pain feels as if it was caused by lifting something too heavy.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे भारी चीज़ उठाने से पीठ में दर्द हो गया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise bhari cheez uthane se pith mein dard ho gya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, overlifting, as from, dorsal region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The back pain in the upper-middle back area feels as if it was caused by lifting something too heavy.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे भारी चीज़ उठाने से पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में दर्द हो गया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise bhari cheez uthane se pith ke beech wale hisse mein dard ho gya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, overlifting, as from, dorsal region, scapulae
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The back pain around the shoulder blade area feels as if it was caused by lifting something too heavy.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे भारी चीज़ उठाने से कंधे के पास पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में दर्द हो गया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise bhari cheez uthane se kandhe ke paas pith ke beech wale hisse mein dard ho gya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, overlifting, as from, lumbar region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The lower back pain feels as if it was caused by lifting something too heavy.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे भारी चीज़ उठाने से कमर में दर्द हो गया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise bhari cheez uthane se kamar mein dard ho gya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, cervical region, extending
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back of the neck that spreads to other areas.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गर्दन में दबाने जैसा दर्द होता है जो कहीं और फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gardan mein dbaane jaisa dard hota hai jo kahin aur failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, cervical region, extending to clavicle
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back of the neck that spreads to the collarbone.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गर्दन में दबाने जैसा दर्द होता है जो कॉलरबोन तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gardan mein dabane jaisa dard hota hai jo collarbone tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, cervical region, extending, to head
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back of the neck that spreads up to the head.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गर्दन में दबाने जैसा दर्द होता है जो सिर तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gardan mein dabane jaisa dard hota hai jo sir tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, cervical region, extending, to, occiput
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back of the neck that spreads to the back of the skull.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गर्दन में दबाने जैसा दर्द होता है जो सिर के पीछे वाले हिस्से तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gardan mein dabane jaisa dard hota hai jo sir ke peeche wale hisse tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, cervical region, intermittent
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back of the neck that comes and goes.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गर्दन में दबाने जैसा दर्द कभी होता है कभी नहीं होता, आता-जाता रहता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gardan mein dabane jaisa dard kabhi hota hai kabhi nahi hota, aata-jata rehta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, cervical region, small spots
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back of the neck felt in small specific spots.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गर्दन में दबाने जैसा दर्द छोटी-छोटी जगहों पर होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gardan mein dabane jaisa dard chhoti-chhoti jagahon par hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, cervical region, weight
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back of the neck with a sensation of heaviness or weight.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गर्दन में दबाने जैसा भारीपन का दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gardan mein dabane jaisa bharipan ka dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, cervical region, weight, as from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back of the neck that feels like something heavy is pressing down on it.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे गर्दन पर कोई भारी चीज़ रखी हो और दर्द हो रहा हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise gardan par koi bhari cheez rakhi ho aur dard ho raha ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, dorsal region, foreign body, as of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the mid-back that feels as if a foreign object is lodged there.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में ऐसा लगता है जैसे कोई बाहरी चीज़ अंदर घुसी हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke beech wale hisse mein aisa lagta hai jaise koi bahari chiz andar ghusi ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, dorsal region, inward
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the mid-back that feels like it is pushing inward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में अंदर की तरफ दबाने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke beech wale hisse mein andar ki taraf dabane jaisa dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, dorsal region, scapulae, as from a plug
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain at the shoulder blades that feels like a plug is stuck there.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कंधे की हड्डी पर ऐसा दबाने जैसा दर्द होता है जैसे कोई खूँटी ठोकी गई हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kandhe ki haddi par aisa dabane jaisa dard hota hai jaise koi khunti thoki gayi ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, dorsal region, scapulae, between, stooping, as if plug were forced inward
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain between the shoulder blades when bending forward, as if a plug were being pushed inward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: झुकने पर दोनों कंधों के बीच पीठ में ऐसा दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है मानो कोई डाट अंदर की तरफ धकेली जा रही हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Jhukne par donon kandhon ke beech pith mein aisa dbaav jaisa dard hota hai mano koi dat andar ki taraf dhakeli ja rahi ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, dorsal region, scapulae, extending
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain at the shoulder blades that spreads to other areas.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कंधे की हड्डी में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो दूसरी जगह फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kandhe ki haddi mein dbaav jaisa dard hota hai jo dusri jagah failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, dorsal region, scapulae, extending, sternum
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain at the shoulder blades that spreads to the breastbone.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कंधे की हड्डी में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो सीने की हड्डी (सीने के बीच) तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kandhe ki haddi mein dbaav jaisa dard hota hai jo sine ki haddi (sine ke beech) tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, dorsal region, scapulae, extending, to sacrum
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain at the shoulder blades that spreads down to the tailbone area.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कंधे की हड्डी में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो त्रिकास्थि (रीढ़ की हड्डी के सबसे नीचे) तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kandhe ki haddi mein dbaav jaisa dard hota hai jo trikaasthi (riddh ki haddi ke sabse neeche) tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, dorsal region, scapulae, right, as from a plug
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain at the right shoulder blade that feels like a plug is stuck there.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दाईं कंधे की हड्डी में ऐसा दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है मानो कोई डाट ठुकी हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Dayin kandhe ki haddi mein aisa dabav jaisa dard hota hai mano koi dat thuki ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, extending to shoulders
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back that spreads to the shoulders.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दबाव जैसा पीठ का दर्द कंधों तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Dabav jaisa peeth ka dard kandhon tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, extending
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that spreads to other areas.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो दूसरी जगह फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein dabav jaisa dard hota hai jo dusri jagah failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, extending to bladder and groins
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that spreads to the bladder and groin areas.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो मूत्राशय और कमर/जाँघ के जोड़ वाले हिस्से तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein dabav jaisa dard hota hai jo mutrashy aur kamar/jangh ke jod vale hisse tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, extending, below the short ribs
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that spreads below the lower ribs.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो छोटी पसलियों के नीचे तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein dabav jaisa dard hota hai jo chhoti paslion ke neeche tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, extending, feet
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that spreads down to the feet.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो पैरों तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein dbav jaisa dard hota hai jo pairon tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, extending, groin
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that spreads to the groin.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो कमर/जाँघ के जोड़ वाले हिस्से तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein dbav jaisa dard hota hai jo kamar/jangah ke jod vale hisse tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, extending, lower limbs
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that spreads down into the legs.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो टाँगों तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein dbav jaisa dard hota hai jo tangon tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, extending, upward
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that spreads upward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो ऊपर की तरफ फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein dbav jaisa dard hota hai jo upar ki taraf failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, inward
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that feels like it is pushing inward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में अंदर की तरफ दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein andar ki taraf dbav jaisa dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, outward
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that feels like it is pushing outward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में बाहर की तरफ दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein bahar ki taraf dbav jaisa dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, paralytic
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that feels like the muscles have lost their strength (a weak, heavy pressing sensation).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जैसे वहाँ की ताकत खत्म हो गई हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein dbav jaisa dard hota hai jaise wahan ki taakat khatm ho gai ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, plug, like a, puts pillow under
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that feels like a plug is stuck there, making you want to put a pillow under it.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में ऐसा दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है मानो कोई डाट ठुकी हो, जिससे तकिया लगाने की जरूरत पड़ती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein aisa dbav jaisa dard hota hai mano koi dat thuki ho, jisse takiya lagane ki zaroorat padti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, vise, as if in a
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the lower back that feels like the area is being squeezed in a vice.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर में ऐसा दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है मानो किसी शिकंजे में दबाया जा रहा हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar mein aisa dabav jaisa dard hota hai mano kisi shikanje mein dabaya ja raha ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, plug-like sensation
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back that feels like a plug is stuck in it.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ में डाट ठुकने जैसा दबाव का एहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth mein daat thukne jaisa dabav ka ehsaas hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, plug-like sensation, sacral region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the sacrum (the triangular bone at the base of the spine just above the tailbone) that feels like a plug is stuck there.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के निचले हिस्से (त्रिकास्थि) में डाट ठुकने जैसा दबाव का एहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke nichle hisse (trikasthi) mein daat thukne jaisa dabao ka ehsas hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, pulsating
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the back with a throbbing or pulsating sensation.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है जो धड़कता भी है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith mein dabao jaisa dard hota hai jo dhadkta bhi hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, sacral region, dull instrument, as from a
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the sacrum that feels as if a blunt object is pressing on it.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ के सबसे निचले हिस्से (त्रिकास्थि) में किसी भोथरी चीज से दबाने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pith ke sabse nichle hisse (trikasthi) mein kisi bhotri chiz se dabane jaisa dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pressing, sacral region, pressing down
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A pressing pain in the sacrum that feels like it is pressing downward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: त्रिकास्थि में नीचे की तरफ दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Trikasthi mein niche ki taraf dabao jaisa dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, pushed, as if being
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation in the back as if being pushed or shoved.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ में ऐसा लगता है जैसे कोई धक्का दे रहा हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peetha mein aisa lagta hai jaise koi dhakka de raha ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, sacral region, fall, as from a
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Pain at the base of the spine that feels as if caused by a fall or blow.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: त्रिकास्थि (पीठ के सबसे नीचे का हिस्सा) में ऐसा दर्द जैसे कहीं से गिर पड़े हों।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Trikasthi (peeth ke sabse neeche ka hissa) mein aisa dard jaise kahin se gir pade hon.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, sacral region, lying, on something hard, as from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Pain at the base of the spine that feels as if lying on something hard.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: लेटने पर ऐसा लगता है जैसे कमर के निचले हिस्से में कोई सख्त चीज़ चुभ रही हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Letne par aisa lagta hai jaise kamar ke neeche hisse mein koi sakht cheez chubh rahi ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, sore, spine, spinal irritation
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The spine is sore, bruised, and irritated — very sensitive to touch or pressure.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी में जलन या खिंचाव जैसी पीड़ा है (स्पाइनल इरिटेशन)।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Ridh ki haddi mein jalan ya khinchaav jaisi pida hai (spinal irritation).

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, spine, extending
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is pain along the spine that spreads or shoots outward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी का दर्द फैल रहा है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Ridh ki haddi ka dard fail raha hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, spine, extending from coccyx to occiput, drawing head backward
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is pain that runs all the way up the spine from the tailbone to the base of the skull, pulling the head backward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी में दर्द है जो पूँछ की हड्डी (कोक्सिक्स) से सिर के पीछे तक फैलता है और सिर पीछे की ओर खिंचता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Ridh ki haddi mein dard hai jo pooch ki haddi se sar ke peeche tak failta hai aur sar peeche ki or khichchta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, spine, extending, down
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is pain along the spine that shoots or spreads downward.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी में दर्द है जो नीचे की ओर फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Ridh ki haddi mein dard hai jo neeche ki or failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, spine, extending, epigastrium, to
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is pain along the spine that spreads to the upper-middle belly.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी में दर्द है जो पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Ridh ki haddi mein dard hai jo pet ke upri hisse tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, spine, extending, lower extremities, to
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is pain along the spine that shoots or spreads down into the legs.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी में दर्द है जो टाँगों तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Ridh ki haddi mein dard hai jo tangnon tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, spine, extending, occiput, to
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is pain along the spine that spreads up to the base of the skull.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी में दर्द है जो सिर के पीछे तक फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Ridh ki haddi mein dard hai jo sar ke peeche tak failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, spine, extending, up spine
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is pain along the spine that spreads upward along the spine.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रीढ़ की हड्डी में दर्द है जो ऊपर की ओर फैलता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Ridh ki haddi mein dard hai jo upar ki or failta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, sprained, as if, lumbar region, extending to abdomen
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The lower back feels as if it has been sprained or badly twisted, with the pain spreading into the belly.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर के निचले हिस्से में मोच जैसा दर्द होता है जो पेट तक फैल जाता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar ke neeche hisse mein moch jaisa dard hota hai jo pet tak fail jata hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, sprained, as if, lumbar region, extending, above hip sitting and standing
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The lower back feels as if it has been sprained or badly twisted, with the pain spreading above the hip while sitting or standing.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: बैठने और खड़े होने पर कमर के ऊपर कूल्हे के पास मोच जैसा दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Baithe aur khade hone par kamar ke upar kulhe ke paas moch jaisa dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, sprained, as if, lumbar region, extending, to gluteal muscles
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The lower back feels as if it has been sprained or badly twisted, with the pain spreading into the buttock muscles.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर के निचले हिस्से में मोच जैसा दर्द होता है जो नितंबों की मांसपेशियों तक फैल जाता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar ke neeche hisse mein moch jaisa dard hota hai jo nitambon ki mans peshiyon tak fail jata hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, sprained, as if, lumbar region, extending, to, hips, afternoon and evening
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The lower back feels as if it has been sprained or badly twisted, with the pain spreading into the hips in the afternoon and evening.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दोपहर और शाम को कमर के निचले हिस्से में मोच जैसा दर्द होता है जो कूल्हों तक फैल जाता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Dopahar aur sham ko kamar ke neeche hisse mein moch jaisa dard hota hai jo kulhon tak fail jata hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, pain, stepping, false
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A false or misleading stepping sensation in the back — a pain that feels as if a step has been misjudged.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गलत कदम पड़ने पर पीठ में दर्द होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Galat kadam padne par peeth mein dard hota hai.

Gas & digestion.path: Back, pain, aching, dull pain, lumbar region, flatus, after, amel.
Gas & digestion.en: My dull aching lower back pain gets better after passing wind.
Gas & digestion.hi: कमर में दर्द होता है जो गैस निकलने के बाद कम हो जाता है।
Gas & digestion.roman: Kamar mein dard hota hai jo gas nikalne ke baad kam ho jata hai.

Gas & digestion.en: A back pain that gets better after burping.
Gas & digestion.hi: डकार आने से पीठ का दर्द कम हो जाता है।
Gas & digestion.roman: dakar aane se peeth ka dard kam ho jata hai.

Gas & digestion.en: Back pain that gets better after passing gas.
Gas & digestion.hi: गैस (वायु) निकलने से पीठ का दर्द कम हो जाता है।
Gas & digestion.roman: Gas (vayu) nikalne se peeth ka dard kam ho jata hai.

Gas & digestion.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, flatus, passing amel.
Gas & digestion.en: Lower back pain that gets better after passing gas.
Gas & digestion.hi: गैस निकलने पर कमर का दर्द कम हो जाता है।
Gas & digestion.roman: Gas nikalne par kamar ka dard kam ho jata hai.

Gas & digestion.path: Back, pain, pressing, lumbar region, flatus, obstructed from
Gas & digestion.en: A pressing pain in the lower back caused by trapped wind (gas that cannot pass).
Gas & digestion.hi: पेट की गैस रुकने से कमर में दबाव जैसा दर्द होता है।
Gas & digestion.roman: Pet ki gas rukne se kamar mein dbav jaisa dard hota hai.

Gas & digestion.path: Back, pain, sacral region, flatus, passing amel.
Gas & digestion.en: Pain at the base of the spine that gets better when passing gas.
Gas & digestion.hi: गैस (वायु) निकलने पर त्रिकास्थि (पीठ के सबसे नीचे का हिस्सा) का दर्द कम हो जाता है।
Gas & digestion.roman: Gas (vayu) nikalne par trikasthi (peeth ke sabse neeche ka hissa) ka dard kam ho jata hai.

Gas & digestion.path: Back, pain, stitching, dorsal region, scapulae, between, eructations, during
Gas & digestion.en: A sharp, stitching pain between the shoulder blades that occurs while burping.
Gas & digestion.hi: डकार आने के दौरान दोनों कंधे की हड्डियों के बीच चुभन जैसा दर्द होता है।
Gas & digestion.roman: Dakar aane ke dauran donon kandhe ki haddiyon ke beech chubhan jaisa dard hota hai.

General sensation.path: Back, pain, aching, dull pain, paroxysmal
General sensation.en: A dull, aching pain in the back that comes and goes in distinct episodes or waves.
General sensation.hi: पीठ में दर्द अचानक उठता है और कुछ देर बाद चला जाता है, बार-बार ऐसा होता है।
General sensation.roman: Pith mein dard achanak uthta hai aur kuch der baad chala jata hai, bar-bar aisa hota hai.

General sensation.en: Back pain that travels upward along the spine.
General sensation.hi: पीठ का दर्द ऊपर की तरफ चढ़ता है।
General sensation.roman: Peetha ka dard upar ki taraf chadta hai.

General sensation.en: Back pain that travels both upward and downward along the spine.
General sensation.hi: पीठ का दर्द कभी ऊपर चढ़ता है और कभी नीचे उतरता है।
General sensation.roman: Peetha ka dard kabhi upar chadta hai aur kabhi neeche utrata hai.

General sensation.path: Back, pain, ascends, spreading upwards like a fan
General sensation.en: Back pain that travels upward and fans out or spreads upward like a fan.
General sensation.hi: पीठ का दर्द पंखे की तरह फैलते हुए ऊपर की तरफ चढ़ता है।
General sensation.roman: Pith ka dard pankhe ki tarah failte hue upar ki taraf chadta hai.

General sensation.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, standing, erect, impossible
General sensation.en: Lower back pain that is so bad it is impossible to stand up straight.
General sensation.hi: सीधे खड़े होना मुश्किल हो जाता है क्योंकि कमर में दर्द होता है।
General sensation.roman: sidhe khade hona mushkil ho jata hai kyunki kamar mein dard hota hai.

General sensation.en: Back pain that moves around to different spots.
General sensation.hi: पीठ का दर्द एक जगह नहीं रहता, इधर-उधर घूमता रहता है।
General sensation.roman: Pith ka dard ek jagah nahin rehta, idhar-udhar ghumta rehta hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: A burning pain in the back that comes on after grief or emotional upset.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: दुख या शोक के बाद पीठ में जलन होती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Dukh ya shok ke baad pith mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, mortification, after
Linked to emotion/excitement.en: Lower back pain that comes on after being humiliated or deeply embarrassed.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: किसी बात पर बहुत शर्मिंदगी या अपमान महसूस होने के बाद कमर में दर्द होता है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Kisi baat par bahut sharmindgi ya apmaan mehsus hone ke baad kamar mein dard hota hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.path: Back, pain, lumbar region, vexation, after
Linked to emotion/excitement.en: There is lower back pain that comes on after becoming angry or upset.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: किसी बात से मन खराब होने या गुस्सा आने के बाद कमर में दर्द होता है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Kisi baat se man kharab hone ya gussa aane ke baad kamar mein dard hota hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: Back pain that comes on after feeling angry or upset.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: किसी बात पर गुस्सा या परेशान होने के बाद पीठ में दर्द होता है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Kisi baat par gussa ya pareshaan hone ke baad peeṭh mein dard hota hai.

Linked to specific situations.en: Back pain that occurs during labor (childbirth).
Linked to specific situations.hi: प्रसव (बच्चे के जन्म) के दौरान पीठ में दर्द होता है।
Linked to specific situations.roman: Prasav ke dauran pith mein dard hota hai.

Sounds & movement.en: There is a rumbling sensation felt in the back.
Sounds & movement.hi: पीठ में गड़गड़ाहट जैसा दर्द होता है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Peetha mein gadgadahat jaisa dard hota hai.

Sounds & movement.path: Back, pain, rumbling, dorsal region, scapulae
Sounds & movement.en: There is a rumbling sensation felt around the shoulder blades in the upper back.

General sensation.en: The mid-back area trembles or shakes.
General sensation.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में कंपकंपी महसूस होती है।
General sensation.roman: Pith ke beech wale hisse mein kampkampi mehsus hoti hai.

General sensation.en: The shoulder blade area trembles or shakes.
General sensation.hi: कंधे के पीछे वाली हड्डी (shoulder blade) के पास कंपकंपी महसूस होती है।
General sensation.roman: Kandhe ke peeche wali haddi ke paas kampkampi mehsus hoti hai.

General sensation.path: Back, trembling, dorsal region, scapulae, forenoon
General sensation.en: The shoulder blade area trembles or shakes during the late morning hours.
General sensation.hi: सुबह के पहले हिस्से में कंधे के पीछे वाली हड्डी के पास कंपकंपी महसूस होती है।
General sensation.roman: Subah ke pehle hisse mein kandhe ke peeche wali haddi ke paas kampkampi mehsus hoti hai.

General sensation.en: The lower back trembles or shakes.
General sensation.hi: कमर के निचले हिस्से में कंपकंपी महसूस होती है।
General sensation.roman: Kamar ke neeche hisse mein kampkampi mehsus hoti hai.

General sensation.en: The back trembling or shaking comes on in sudden episodes or spasms.
General sensation.hi: पीठ में अचानक दौरे की तरह कंपकंपी आती है।
General sensation.roman: Pith mein achanak daure ki tarah kampkampi aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, trembling, fever, during
Comes with other symptoms.en: The back trembles or shakes during a fever.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बुखार के दौरान पीठ में कंपकंपी महसूस होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bukhar ke dauran pith mein kampkampi mehsus hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, trembling, lumbar region, sensation of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation as if the lower back is trembling or shaking, even without visible movement.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: कमर के निचले हिस्से में कंपकंपी जैसी अनुभूति होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Kamar ke neeche hisse mein kampkampi jaisi anubhuti hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Back, trembling, morning
Linked to time of day.en: The back trembles or shakes in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह पीठ में कंपकंपी महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah pith mein kampkampi mehsus hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are fatty lumps or growths on the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन पर चर्बी की गाँठ है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan par charbi ki ganth hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are malignant (cancerous) growths on the neck.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गर्दन पर कैंसर जैसी खतरनाक गाँठ है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gardan par cancer jaisi khatarnak ganth hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, tumors, pedunculated bluish as large as a cherry
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are stalked, bluish growths on the back, about the size of a cherry.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर नीले रंग की, चेरी के बराबर बड़ी, डंडी वाली गाँठ है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par nile rang ki, cherry ke barabar badi, dandi wali ganth hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are sarcoma-type growths on the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पीठ पर एक प्रकार की मांसपेशियों की कैंसरनुमा गाँठ (सार्कोमा) है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Peeth par ek prakar ki mansapeshiyon ki cancernuma ganth (sarcoma) hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, turning, agg.
Triggered by specific actions.en: Turning the back or body makes the back symptom worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पीठ को घुमाने या पलटने पर तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Peeth ko ghumane ya paltne par taklif badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, turning, head
Triggered by specific actions.en: Turning the head causes a back symptom.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: सिर घुमाने पर पीठ में तकलीफ होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sir ghumane par peeth mein taklif hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, turning, head, agg.
Triggered by specific actions.en: Turning the head makes the back symptom worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: सिर घुमाने पर पीठ में तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sir ghumane par peeth mein taklif badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, turning, head, left, agg.
Triggered by specific actions.en: Turning the head to the left makes the back symptom worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: सिर को बाईं तरफ घुमाने पर पीठ में तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sir ko bain taraf ghumane par peeth mein taklif badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, turning, the body, agg.
Triggered by specific actions.en: Turning the body makes the back symptom worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: शरीर को घुमाने पर पीठ में तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sharir ko ghumane par peeth mein taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Back, turning, over in bed, agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: Turning over in bed makes the back symptom worse.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर पर करवट बदलने पर पीठ में तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Bistar par karvat badlne par peeth mein taklif badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, twitching and jerking, breathing
Triggered by specific actions.en: The back twitches and jerks when breathing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: साँस लेने पर पीठ में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Saans lne par peeth mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, twitching and jerking, cervical region, tearing, extending into vertex, while walking
Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a tearing sensation in the neck that extends up to the top of the head while walking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: चलते समय गर्दन के पास तेज खिंचाव के साथ झटके महसूस होते हैं जो सिर के ऊपर तक जाते हैं।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Chalte samay gardan ke pas tez khinchhav ke sath jhatke mehsus hote hain jo sir ke uper tak jate hain.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, twitching and jerking, dorsal region, manual work
Triggered by specific actions.en: The mid-back area twitches and jerks during manual or hand work.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हाथ से काम करने के दौरान पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hath se kaam karne ke dauran peeth ke beech wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lumbar region, lifting, after
Triggered by specific actions.en: The lower back twitches and jerks after lifting something.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कुछ उठाने के बाद कमर के निचले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kuch uthane ke baad kamar ke niche wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lumbar region, motion, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: The lower back twitches and jerks when moving.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-डुलने पर कमर के निचले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hilne-dulne par kamar ke niche wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lumbar region, stooping
Triggered by specific actions.en: The lower back twitches and jerks when bending forward.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: आगे झुकने पर कमर के निचले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Aage jhukne par kamar ke niche wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lumbar region, walking
Triggered by specific actions.en: The lower back twitches and jerks when walking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: चलने पर कमर के निचले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Chalne par kamar ke niche wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, twitching and jerking, opening the mouth, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: The back twitches and jerks when opening the mouth.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: मुँह खोलने पर पीठ में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Munh kholne par peeth mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

General sensation.path: Back, twitching and jerking, cervical region
General sensation.en: The neck area twitches and jerks.
General sensation.hi: गर्दन के पास (ऊपरी रीढ़) में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Gardan ke pas (uper ridh) mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

General sensation.en: The tailbone area twitches and jerks.
General sensation.hi: पूँछ की हड्डी (coccyx / tailbone) में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Pooch ki haddi (coccyx / tailbone) mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

General sensation.path: Back, twitching and jerking, coccyx, painful
General sensation.en: The tailbone area twitches and jerks painfully.
General sensation.hi: पूँछ की हड्डी (tailbone) में दर्द के साथ फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Pooch ki haddi (tailbone) mein dard ke sath fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

General sensation.path: Back, twitching and jerking, dorsal region
General sensation.en: The mid-back area twitches and jerks.
General sensation.hi: पीठ के बीच वाले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Peeth ke beech wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

General sensation.path: Back, twitching and jerking, dorsal region, scapulae
General sensation.en: The shoulder blade area twitches and jerks.
General sensation.hi: कंधे के पीछे वाली हड्डी (shoulder blade) के पास फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Kandhe ke peeche wali haddi ke paas fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

General sensation.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lumbar region
General sensation.en: The lower back twitches and jerks.
General sensation.hi: कमर के निचले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Kamar ke niche wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

General sensation.en: The right side of the back twitches and jerks.
General sensation.hi: पीठ के दाहिने हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Peeth ke dahine hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

General sensation.path: Back, twitching and jerking, sacral region
General sensation.en: The sacrum area (the flat bone at the base of the spine, just above the tailbone) twitches and jerks.
General sensation.hi: पीठ की निचली हड्डी (sacrum) के आसपास फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Peeth ki nichi haddi ke aaspass fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

General sensation.en: The spine itself twitches and jerks.
General sensation.hi: मेरी रीढ़ की हड्डी में अचानक झटके या फड़कन होती है।
General sensation.roman: Meri reedh ki haddi mein achanak jhatke ya fadkan hoti hai.

General sensation.en: The vertebrae (spinal bones) twitch and jerk.
General sensation.hi: मेरी पीठ की कशेरुकाओं (हड्डियों) में अचानक झटके और फड़कन होती है।
General sensation.roman: Meri peeth ki kasherukaon mein achanak jhatke aur fadkan hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Back, twitching and jerking, cervical region, rest, during
Linked to posture/position.en: The neck area twitches and jerks while resting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: आराम के दौरान गर्दन के पास (ऊपरी रीढ़) में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Aaram ke dauran gardan ke pas (uper ridh) mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Linked to posture/position.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lumbar region, lying, while
Linked to posture/position.en: The lower back twitches and jerks while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटे रहने के दौरान कमर के निचले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Lete rahne ke dauran kamar ke niche wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Linked to posture/position.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lumbar region, sitting
Linked to posture/position.en: The lower back twitches and jerks while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठने पर कमर के निचले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baitne par kamar ke niche wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Linked to posture/position.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lying on back, while
Linked to posture/position.en: The back twitches and jerks while lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने पर पीठ में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Peeth ke bal letne par peeth mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Back, twitching and jerking, coccyx, menses, during
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: The tailbone area twitches and jerks during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान पूँछ की हड्डी (tailbone) में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran pooch ki haddi (tailbone) mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, twitching and jerking, like electric shocks
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The back twitches and jerks with sensations like electric shocks.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पीठ में बिजली के झटके जैसी फड़कन महसूस होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Peeth mein bijli ke jhatke jaisi fadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lumbar region, 1 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The lower back twitches and jerks at around 1 o'clock in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर एक बजे कमर के निचले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ek baje kamar ke niche wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lumbar region, evening
Linked to time of day.en: The lower back twitches and jerks in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को कमर के निचले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko kamar ke niche wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Back, twitching and jerking, lumbar region, evening, in bed
Linked to time of day.en: The lower back twitches and jerks in the evening while in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर लेटने पर कमर के निचले हिस्से में फड़कन या झटके महसूस होते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bistar par letne par kamar ke niche wale hisse mein fadkan ya jhatke mehsus hote hain.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, ulcerated, as if
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The back feels as if it has open sores or raw ulcers, even though none are visible.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: मेरी पीठ में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वहाँ घाव हो गया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Meri pith mein aisa lagta hai jaise wahan ghav ho gaya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, ulcerated, as if, spine
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The spine feels as if it has open sores or raw ulcers.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: मेरी रीढ़ की हड्डी में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वहाँ घाव हो गया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Meri reedh ki haddi mein aisa lagta hai jaise wahan ghav ho gaya ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Back, ulcerated, as if, vertebrae
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The vertebrae (spinal bones) feel as if they have open sores or raw ulcers.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: मेरी पीठ की कशेरुकाओं में ऐसा लगता है जैसे वहाँ घाव हो गया हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Meri pith ki kasherukaon mein aisa lagta hai jaise wahan ghav ho gaya ho.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are open sores or ulcers in the neck area of the back.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: मेरी गर्दन के पिछले हिस्से में घाव हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Meri gardan ke pichle hisse mein ghav hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are open sores or ulcers on the tailbone area.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: मेरी पीठ के नीचे रीढ़ की सबसे आखिरी हड्डी (टेलबोन) पर घाव है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Meri pith ke neeche reedh ki sabse aakhri haddi (tailbon) par ghav hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are open sores or ulcers on or around the shoulder blades.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: मेरे कंधे के पास पीठ पर (स्कैपुला के पास) घाव है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Mere kandhe ke paas pith par (scapula ke paas) ghav hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are open sores or ulcers on the sacrum (the flat bone at the base of the spine).
Skin/tissue changes.hi: मेरी पीठ के निचले हिस्से में त्रिकास्थि (sacrum) पर घाव है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Meri pith ke neeche hisse mein trikasthi par ghav hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Back, ulcers, sacrum, burn like fire
Skin/tissue changes.en: There are open sores or ulcers on the sacrum that burn like fire.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: मेरी पीठ के निचले हिस्से में त्रिकास्थि पर घाव है जो आग जैसा जलता है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Meri pith ke neeche hisse mein trikasthi par ghav hai jo aag jaisa jalta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, urinating, after, amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: The back symptom gets better after urinating.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पेशाब करने के बाद मेरी पीठ की तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Peshaab karne ke baad meri pith ki takleef kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Back, urinating, when, agg.
Triggered by specific actions.en: The back symptom gets worse while urinating.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पेशाब करते वक्त मेरी पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Peshaab karte waqt meri pith ki takleef badh jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, vomiting, after, agg.
Comes with other symptoms.en: The back symptom gets worse after vomiting.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: उल्टी होने के बाद मेरी पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Ulti hone ke baad meri pith ki takleef badh jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, vomiting, agg.
Comes with other symptoms.en: Vomiting makes the back symptom worse.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: उल्टी होने से मेरी पीठ की तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Ulti hone se meri pith ki takleef badh jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Back, vomiting, when, agg.
